changes.comment: A disposed store is inert: `emit()` resolves `{ committed: false }` without running anything, `call()` rejects with `CallAbortedError("store disposed")` as does every call still pending, and `register*`, `with*`, `onEffect`, `replace*` and `hotReplace` throw naming the store. A late `emit` or `call` is reported once per method in development as `use-after-dispose`. `dispose()` is idempotent. New `store.signal`, an `AbortSignal` created on first read and aborted last in `dispose()`. A `call()` whose signal is already aborted no longer sends its request or arms a timer.
